evals.name: pass-healthy-week
evals.prompt: Weekly KPI export for 2026-W38 is in metrics_2026-W38.csv. Can you run the weekly metrics review on it before tomorrow's ops sync? Save the review as review.md.
evals.expected_output: Verdict PASS. Every metric is on the right side of target and no metric moved more than 10% in the bad direction. Flagged section says None.

assertions.text: The Flagged section lists exactly the expected metrics (none)
Every metric from the input CSV appears in the Metrics table

evals.name: pass-near-miss-week
evals.prompt: here's this week's numbers (metrics_2026-W39.csv). WAU and conversion dipped a bit and error rate is sitting right at 0.50 - is anything actually flag-worthy or are we fine? write it up in review.md pls
evals.expected_output: Verdict PASS. WAU (-8.2%), conversion (-8.5%), tickets (+9.1%) are within the 10% tolerance and on target; error_rate_pct equals its target, which is OK; p95 latency improved 22.9%, which is a good-direction move and must not be flagged.

assertions.text: The Flagged section lists exactly the expected metrics (none)
Every metric from the input CSV appears in the Metrics table

evals.name: flag-incident-week
evals.prompt: We had the payments-gateway incident on Tuesday. KPI file for the week is metrics_2026-W40.csv — do the weekly metrics review and tell me what has to go in front of leadership. Output to review.md.
evals.expected_output: Verdict FLAG with p95_latency_ms, error_rate_pct and support_tickets flagged (each missed target and regressed >10% WoW). WAU, conversion and revenue are OK and must not be flagged.

assertions.text: The Flagged section lists exactly the expected metrics (p95_latency_ms, error_rate_pct, support_tickets)
Every metric from the input CSV appears in the Metrics table

evals.name: flag-wow-drop-and-data-gap
evals.prompt: Finance hasn't closed the books yet so revenue might be blank, but can you still do the W41 metrics review from metrics_2026-W41.csv? Everything's above target so I'm assuming it's a clean week. Put it in review.md.
evals.expected_output: Verdict FLAG despite every reported metric being above target: signup_conversion_pct dropped 12.6% WoW (wow_regression) and net_revenue_usd has no this_week value (missing_data).

assertions.text: The Flagged section lists exactly the expected metrics (signup_conversion_pct, net_revenue_usd)
Every metric from the input CSV appears in the Metrics table
